svg.title: C1 style sheet — geometric flat
svg.text: Flat fills, no outlines, one shade per material, line only where a fill cannot carry the shape. Character style sheet for comparison with C2–C5.
Fills have no stroke. Lines exist for three things only (values at 256 px):
brow — 4 px rounded stroke, hair-shade colour
closed mouth — 3 px rounded stroke, ink
glasses — 2.6 px (thicken to 4 px below 48 px)
Light from top-left. One flat shade per material (base → 18 % #3B2A2A).
shade lives on the right jaw, under the fringe,
under the chin (neck band) and inside ears
blush = flat ellipse from the skin table
nose = one shade shape, no line
Warm skin ramp (7 steps, each with its blush), then hair, garment and background families. Touching materials differ by ≥ 0.12 luminance.
portrait backgrounds: flat tint + one offset disc
Each head at 96 / 48 / 24 px, then the same row desaturated. Silhouettes (hair mass, apron bib, glasses, bob) stay distinct.
LangQuest · design/explorations/C1 · system fonts only · original work
